Debt / Loan Overview
Add Debt / Loan
Log a Payment / Settlement
Records a partial (or full) payment against a debt/loan. If an account is selected, it's also recorded as a transfer — never counted as an income/expense. Fully paying off the remaining balance marks it settled automatically.
All Debts & Loans
Credit Card Overview
Purchases on a card increase its outstanding balance. Bill payments settle it — they're never counted as an expense.
Add Credit Card
Record a Purchase
Adds to the card's outstanding balance and logs it as an expense.
Record Payment / Bill Settlement
Deducts from the source account and reduces outstanding — treated as a transfer, not an expense.

❓ FAQ
Cash Flow Forecast
Projected — based on your recorded financial data (ESTIMATE). Formula: Current Balance + Scheduled Recurring Income − Scheduled Recurring Expenses − Upcoming EMIs/Card Dues − Planned Goal Contributions.

Projected Balance Timeline

Forecast Breakdown
Can I Spend This?
Checks your planned purchase against available cash, upcoming 30-day commitments, this month's budget room, and your emergency fund status.
